name: net_session_browser_dialog_help_docs_find_executable_error_class_table
description: NetSessionBrowserDialog::kHelpDocsFindExecutableErrorClassTable classifies FindExecutableA return codes for OnHelpDocs localized error handling. Direct production host: mission.cpp.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
0x41b8ac is a 32-byte data table referenced by 0x41b7d8/0x41b7de inside NetSessionBrowserDialog::OnHelpDocs, not a standalone callable function.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x41b780 validates indexing this table with FindExecutableA results 0..31, routing classes 0, 1, 2, and 3 to localized messages 32, 34, 36, and 33 respectively, and falling through class 4 to ShellExecuteA.

The native OnHelpDocs smoke patches zLoc::GetMessageString, SHELL32 FindExecutableA/ShellExecuteA, and MFC42 CWnd::MessageBoxA, then verifies success, default fallthrough, and all four localized error-message classes.
